question: Spread: KVC Westerlo (-2.5)
description:
In the upcoming Belgium Pro League game, scheduled for September 5 at 12:15 PM ET:

This market will resolve to "KVC Westerlo" if KVC Westerlo win the game by 3 or more goals.

Otherwise, this market will resolve to "Yellow-Red KV Mechelen".

If the game is postponed, this market will remain open until the game has been completed. If the game is canceled entirely, with no make-up game, this market will resolve 50–50.

This market will resolve according to the official final score published on proleague.be. This market refers only to the outcome within the first 90 minutes of regular play plus stoppage time.

The primary resolution source for this market is the official statistics of the event as recognized by the governing body or event organizers. However, if the governing body or event organizers have not published final match statistics within 2 hours after the event's conclusion, data from Flashscore may be used; if Flashscore data is unavailable, data from Sofascore may be used; if neither is available, a consensus of credible reporting may be used instead. All markets will settle based on the official final result as recognized by the governing body or event organizers. Revisions to officially declared final scores made after market resolution will not be accounted for in determining the outcome.

eventMetadata.context_description: Both teams enter this Belgian Pro League matchup near the foot of the table after poor early-season form, with Mechelen sitting 14th and Westerlo 16th following multiple losses and heavy concessions. Mechelen’s home record offers modest stability compared with Westerlo’s leaky defense and winless run, while historical head-to-head results tilt toward the hosts. Recent lineups highlight ongoing absences in midfield and attack for both sides, limiting attacking output and increasing reliance on set-piece threats or counter transitions. Schedule congestion and limited rest could further test defensive organization in what projects as a low-scoring, tightly contested affair shaped by current standings pressure.
